items.text: Hotel management usually accepts commerce students after 12th, nursing programmes usually require science subjects, and hospital or health administration is the commerce-friendly route into healthcare.
These are rated for how far your own effort can scale beyond a salary.
Hospitality skills can be tested cheaply through small events before investing in a full programme.
